function(cvmmap_find_package_global package_name)
	set(_saved_find_package_targets_global "${CMAKE_FIND_PACKAGE_TARGETS_GLOBAL}")
	set(CMAKE_FIND_PACKAGE_TARGETS_GLOBAL TRUE)
	find_package(${package_name} ${ARGN})
	set(CMAKE_FIND_PACKAGE_TARGETS_GLOBAL "${_saved_find_package_targets_global}" PARENT_SCOPE)
endfunction()

option(BUILD_SPDLOG "Build spdlog" OFF)
if(BUILD_SPDLOG)
	set(SPDLOG_USE_STD_FORMAT ${CVMMAP_HAS_STD_FORMAT})
	if(NOT CVMMAP_HAS_STD_FORMAT)
		set(SPDLOG_FMT_EXTERNAL ON)
	endif()
	add_subdirectory(spdlog)
else()
	cvmmap_find_package_global(spdlog REQUIRED)
endif()
if(NOT TARGET spdlog::spdlog)
	if(TARGET spdlog)
		add_library(spdlog::spdlog INTERFACE IMPORTED GLOBAL)
		set_target_properties(spdlog::spdlog PROPERTIES INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES spdlog)
	else()
		message(FATAL_ERROR "spdlog target not found")
	endif()
endif()

if(NOT CVMMAP_HAS_STD_FORMAT)
	cvmmap_find_package_global(fmt REQUIRED)
	if(NOT TARGET fmt::fmt)
		message(FATAL_ERROR "fmt target not found")
	endif()
endif()

if(NOT CVMMAP_HAS_STD_EXPECTED)
	cvmmap_find_package_global(tl-expected CONFIG REQUIRED)
	if(TARGET tl::expected)
		# Canonical Debian/Ubuntu target.
	elseif(TARGET tl_expected)
		add_library(tl::expected INTERFACE IMPORTED GLOBAL)
		set_target_properties(tl::expected PROPERTIES INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES tl_expected)
	elseif(TARGET expected)
		add_library(tl::expected INTERFACE IMPORTED GLOBAL)
		set_target_properties(tl::expected PROPERTIES INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES expected)
	else()
		message(FATAL_ERROR "tl-expected target not found")
	endif()
endif()

add_library(cvmmap_stb_truetype_headers INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(cvmmap_stb_truetype_headers
	INTERFACE
		"${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/stb"
)

add_subdirectory(CLI11)
add_subdirectory(tomlplusplus)
add_subdirectory(proxy)

set(NATS_BUILD_STREAMING OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(NATS_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(BUILD_TESTING_SAVED ${BUILD_TESTING})
set(BUILD_TESTING OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(nats.c)
if(TARGET nats_static AND NOT TARGET cnats::nats_static)
	add_library(cnats::nats_static INTERFACE IMPORTED GLOBAL)
	set_target_properties(cnats::nats_static PROPERTIES INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES nats_static)
endif()
set(BUILD_TESTING ${BUILD_TESTING_SAVED} CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
